standard_prerequisites: Descent of purity along flat base change: being pure above a point is unaffected by a flat base change of the target
The etale local freeness along the fibre construction producing an etale neighborhood with an affine cover whose module of sections is free over the strictly henselian local ring
Affine locally free (projective) modules are universally pure relative to the base
The two part criterion relating universal purity to the image of the morphism containing the relative assassin
core_obligations: Reduce to Y the spectrum of a strictly henselian local ring R with closed point y: the morphism Spec(O_{Y, ybar}) -> Y is flat from the spectrum of a strictly henselian local ring mapping the closed point to y, and by the flat descent of purity it suffices to treat this case
Apply the etale freeness along the fibre lemma to obtain g: X' -> X etale with g(|X'|) containing |X_y|, X' affine, and Gamma(X', g^*F) a free R-module
Free modules are universally pure relative to the base, so g^*F is universally pure relative to Y

By the criterion relating purity to the image of the relative assassin it suffices that g(|X'|) contains Ass_{X/Y}(F), which follows from the image containing |X_y| by the specialization part of the same criterion
proof_roadmap: Descend to the strictly henselian local case by flat base change
Etale-locally make the module free along the fibre
Conclude universal purity from freeness plus the relative assassin image criterion
